review.assessment: The diff creates solution.py with a paginate function that unconditionally appends the remainder slice after iterating through items, leaving the exact logic responsible for both described misbehaviors intact. The change does not meet the stated scope of eliminating all empty pages; it merely introduces/reveals the buggy implementation without applying a conditional guard.

findings.defect: Unconditional final append attaches a stray empty page when items divide evenly into full pages.
Empty input list bypasses the loop, leaves page as [], and appends it to pages, violating the requirement that empty input should produce no pages.
